title: R-11 engineering-core roadmap rebaseline
reason: The current R-09/R-10 masterdata baseline conflates product models, process semantics, sales options, technical fields, calculation snapshots, and downstream release objects. R-11 must replace the roadmap and beforeSalesOrder dependency with an explicit engineering-core contract before any sales-order runtime work.
checklist: Explain old rule and new rule.
List sample files proving the project base needs this rule.
Run npm run check after the rule proposal is accepted.
